duels.source: realism v2 analysis 2026-10-13 (tackles-report.md, transitions-report.md, finalthird-report.md B2, carrier-report.md C1); spec P4 for defender, attacker and aerial fouls; IDSSE, 7 matches; aggregates only. Support rows: tackles.json real.defender_win_by_n3 (defenders within 3 m of the carrier, tackler included): none = 0.36 (n 326, info); exactly 1 = 0.51 (n 599); 2 or more = 0.60 (n 142 x 0.61 + 16 x 0.50). Bands are plan 8d rulings.

shots.xgFitScope: least squares of logit(DFL xG) on xgOf's features from the shot position (distance to the goal centre in m, goal-mouth angle in rad), header = TypeOfShot head, defenders = max(0, AmountOfDefenders - 1); every ShotAtGoal of the 7 IDSSE matches with AmountOfDefenders, 159 of 171 (the 3 penalties and 9 others have none); least squares in logit space lowers the mean: fitted 0.076 (xgFitMean) against DFL 0.092 (xgDflMean) on the same shots
